format: Studio / Custom events: callback tie at the cut that exceeds Final capacity
requirement: DanceFlow policy (not any governing body's rule): when tied couples at the callback cut-off exceed the Final's capacity (or capacity is unknown), the calculation completes with every row advanced = null (blocked_tie_over_capacity) and approval is refused with COMP_ADVANCEMENT_BLOCKED. No arbitrary manager selection, no runoff and no automatic advance of all tied competitors. Preserved unchanged by OD-14 Option A.
enforcement_point: Callback tally engine (unresolved result) and the cf1_guard_advancement_approval trigger on event_competition_result_versions.

tests.name: apply: an undecided (null advanced) row is COMP_ADVANCEMENT_BLOCKED

interpretation_notes: Approved and tested as written (D-CT-4 2026-10-24; OD-1 option D 2026-10-30), but the policy label and disclosure required by OD-13/OD-14 do not exist on any surface yet, and the SQL test was not run for this docs-only entry. Never to be described as UCWDC, NDCA or WSDC behavior. A runoff (CF2) remains a separate, unapproved candidate. OD-01 (PR 832) restrictions stand.
